entries.title: Sun dasha (6 years)
entries.body: This tradition uses this period to reflect on confidence, responsibility and being heard. What responsibility would you like to handle more clearly, and where could you share the lead? A period is a symbolic timing framework, not a prediction that particular events will happen. Its dates come from the chart engine.
